original_prompt: Generate a CloudFormation template creating a CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing the health of a Lambda-based API: invocations, errors, throttles, and average duration.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Generate a CloudFormation template creating a CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing the health of a Lambda-based API: invocations, errors, throttles, and average duration.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing health of a Lambda-based API (invocations, errors, throttles, average duration)
Parameters:
  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Default: LambdaApiHealth
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Dashboard to create
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    AllowedPattern: '[-a-zA-Z0-9:_./@]+'
  FunctionNamePattern:
    Type: String
    Default: '*'
    Description: Lambda FunctionName pattern to include (supports wildcards, e.g., myapi-*)
  DashboardPeriod:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    Description: Period (in seconds) for metrics on the dashboard (e.g., 60, 300, 900)
    MinValue: 10
Resources:
  LambdaApiHealthDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Ref DashboardName
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Lambda Invocations",
                "legend": { "position": "right" },
                "period": ${DashboardPeriod},
                "stat": "Sum",
                "stacked": false,
                "yAxis": { "left": { "min": 0 } },
                "metrics": [
                  {
                    "expression": "SEARCH('{AWS/Lambda,FunctionName} MetricName=\"Invocations\" AND FunctionName=\"${FunctionNamePattern}\"', 'Sum', ${DashboardPeriod})",
                    "id": "e1",
                    "label": "Invocations (by function)",
                    "region": "${AWS::Region}"
                  },
                  {
                    "expression": "SUM(METRICS())",
                    "id": "e2",
                    "label": "Total Invocations",
                    "region": "${AWS::Region}"
                  }
                ]
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Lambda Errors",
                "legend": { "position": "right" },
                "period": ${DashboardPeriod},
                "stat": "Sum",
                "stacked": false,
                "yAxis": { "left": { "min": 0 } },
                "metrics": [
                  {
                    "expression": "SEARCH('{AWS/Lambda,FunctionName} MetricName=\"Errors\" AND FunctionName=\"${FunctionNamePattern}\"', 'Sum', ${DashboardPeriod})",
                    "id": "e3",
                    "label": "Errors (by function)",
                    "region": "${AWS::Region}"
                  },
                  {
                    "expression": "SUM(METRICS())",
                    "id": "e4",
                    "label": "Total Errors",
                    "region": "${AWS::Region}"
                  }
                ]
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Lambda Throttles",
                "legend": { "position": "right" },
                "period": ${DashboardPeriod},
                "stat": "Sum",
                "stacked": false,
                "yAxis": { "left": { "min": 0 } },
                "metrics": [
                  {
                    "expression": "SEARCH('{AWS/Lambda,FunctionName} MetricName=\"Throttles\" AND FunctionName=\"${FunctionNamePattern}\"', 'Sum', ${DashboardPeriod})",
                    "id": "e5",
                    "label": "Throttles (by function)",
                    "region": "${AWS::Region}"
                  },
                  {
                    "expression": "SUM(METRICS())",
                    "id": "e6",
                    "label": "Total Throttles",
                    "region": "${AWS::Region}"
                  }
                ]
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Lambda Average Duration (ms)",
                "legend": { "position": "right" },
                "period": ${DashboardPeriod},
                "stat": "Average",
                "stacked": false,
                "yAxis": { "left": { "min": 0 } },
                "metrics": [
                  {
                    "expression": "SEARCH('{AWS/Lambda,FunctionName} MetricName=\"Duration\" AND FunctionName=\"${FunctionNamePattern}\"', 'Average', ${DashboardPeriod})",
                    "id": "e7",
                    "label": "Duration (by function)",
                    "region": "${AWS::Region}"
                  },
                  {
                    "expression": "AVG(METRICS())",
                    "id": "e8",
                    "label": "Average Duration (across functions)",
                    "region": "${AWS::Region}"
                  }
                ]
              }
            }
          ]
        }
Outputs:
  DashboardNameOut:
    Description: Name of the created CloudWatch Dashboard
    Value: !Ref LambdaApiHealthDashboard
  DashboardLink:
    Description: Console link to the dashboard
    Value: !Sub https://${AWS::Region}.console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region=${AWS::Region}#dashboards:name=${DashboardName}
